phone.startHint: Tap Start to turn on the microphone and the speaker.
voice.title: Set up a voice
voice.consentIntro: Cadence will copy this voice so spoken replies sound like the person. The voice stays on this laptop and can be deleted at any time.
voice.consentCheck: I am {name}, or {name} has given permission to copy their voice.
voice.sampleIntro: Record about 30 seconds of the voice, or choose an existing recording or video, like a voicemail or home video.
voice.readThis: If you're recording now, read this aloud:
voice.readingText: The sun came out after a long week of rain. I made a cup of tea, opened the window, and listened to the birds. Later I called my sister, and we talked about the garden, the neighbors, and what to cook for dinner on Sunday.
voice.uploading: Creating the voice. This can take a minute.
phrases.title: Saved phrases
phrases.intro: Phrases you say often, grouped by place. They play in your voice from the headset in one action.
phrases.offline: Not connected. Changes will work again once the phone reconnects.
phrases.empty: No groups yet. Add one below.
phrases.editMoves: Saving an edit moves the phrase to the end of its group.
phrases.problem.duplicatePhrase: This group already has that phrase.
phrases.problem.duplicateGroup: There's already a group with that name.
